PB02-G04.name: Godzilla (1994)
PB02-G04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest BP. When this effect destroys, put two cores from the Void to any "Godzilla"-named Spirit(s)/Grandwalker Nexus(es) you control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Effects of opposing Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by your "Godzilla"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus can't activate.

PB02-G08.name: Godzilla (2004)
PB02-G08.effect:
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can pay two costs to summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to this Spirit, and refresh it.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate would leave the Field, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

PB02-G10.name: Atomic Breath
PB02-G10.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Godzilla"-named Spirit effect, or sent to the Trash by the effect of your exactly-named "The God Incarnate Godzilla," you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to any "The God Incarnate Godzilla" you control.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Also, if you control any "Godzilla"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or more Spirit/Ultimate.

PB02-G02.name: Godzilla (2016) Second Form
PB02-G02.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Shin-Godzilla (Second Form)."

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "The God Incarnate Godzilla", and a Red "Godzilla" Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning/deploying a "Godzilla" Spirit card/Grandwalker Nexus card, this Spirit gains two extra Red symbols.

PB02-G01.name: The FlyingGreatKaiju Rodan (1964)
PB02-G01.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 4([Red Core][Red Core][Green Core])]
Destroy an opposing Nexus. When this effect destroys, draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up on your Removed Zone. If you control any "Godzilla"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus, instead of putting it on the Removed Zone, you can summon it, without paying the cost.

PB02-G09.name: The God Incarnate Godzilla
PB02-G09.effect:
[GPGWrule]

[Core Charge: ("Godzilla")]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbols are also treated as Red.

4 [LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, this Nexus is also treated as Spirit with LV1/LV2 20000 BP, and can only be destroyed by Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate attacks, destroy that Spirit/Ultimate.

PB02-G07.name: The InfantIslandGuardian Mothra (1966)
PB02-G07.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put one core from the Void each to this Spirit and any "Godzilla"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[LV1][LV2]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by putting a core from the Void to this Spirit, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The opposing Burst can't activate.

PB02-G03.name: The RowdyDinosaur Anguirus (1968)
PB02-G03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This exhausted Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. At the end of battle, if you control any "Godzilla"-named Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus, once per turn, this Spirit refeshes.

PB02-G05.name: The SpaceSuperKaiju King Ghidorah (1968)
PB02-G05.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Red & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. The effects of the Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
Twice per turn, by sending a core, other than [Soul Core], from your Trash to this Spirit, this Spirit refreshes.

PB02-G06.name: The SpaceViciousBattleBeast Space Godzilla
PB02-G06.effect:
This card/Spirit's name is also treated as being exactly-named "Space Godzilla."

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy two opposing one-symbol Spirits/Ultimates. The effects of Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
While you control any Nexus, this Spirit can't be destroyed nor returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.
